question: In Table 18 (Page 38, 'Chicken Nugget Map'), what two unrelated things does the visual meme combine to create humor?
expected_answer: In Table 18 (Page 38), the meme combines a caption about marveling at beautiful pictures of the Earth from space with an actual photograph of fried chicken nuggets arranged to resemble a map of the world.

gold.evidence: The meme juxtaposes a caption about marveling at the Earth from space with an image of chicken nuggets arranged to resemble a map of the world.

answer: The meme juxtaposes pictures of the Earth from space with chicken nuggets, combining a majestic view of the planet and a mundane snack for comedic effect [gpt4-2023-techreport_p038_text_01].
